Review.feedback: Flipkart generally receives mixed reviews. Many users praise its wide product selection and competitive prices, especially for electronics and gaming. However, a significant number of customers express dissatisfaction with aspects like delivery delays, product quality issues, and unhelpful customer service. Some reviewers also allege that Flipkart manipulates reviews to favor positive ones.
